status: planning inventory; no production assets approved
ownerPolicy: Roles assign responsibility, not a claim of human approval. Coordinator pew-pew-art owns this inventory; the project owner retains release and final art gates.
dimensionPolicy: Physical model metres. 1:87 is the authored railway scale; the full-size carrying case is not divided by 87. Source-reported measurements are never labelled as measured by this team.

assets.label: Original walnut display case, lid, hinges and latches

dimensions.description: Board 0.8 × 0.5 m from ADR-0005. Full closing lid dimensions and internal scenery clearance are not yet designed; the prototype half-depth lid is not a production template.

Current compatibility contract: body length 0.074 m, rigid wheelbase 0.036 m, wheel radius 0.006 m. Final width/height and running-gear clearance require blockout tests; museum engine dimensions are not adopted.
Current body length 0.046 m, wheelbase 0.028 m; coupler socket gap 0.006 m. Door/window dimensions and seating scale remain to be designed, not inherited from the museum model.
Current body length 0.046 m and wheelbase 0.028 m. Original cargo, underframe, buffers and coupling envelopes must fit minimum supported curves.

Gauge between rail-head inner faces 0.0165 m; current 0.001 m rail head gives 0.0175 m centre spacing. Production profile and sleeper geometry need original dimensioned design; concrete-sleeper source is comparison only.
Existing oval permits 0.10–0.20 m radii. General track graph must ratify supported radii; no new graph compatibility is implied by this catalog entry.

assets.label: Functional turnout blade, stock rail and frog kit
assets.owner: railway infrastructure artist and simulation engineer

dimensions.description: Left/right variants required. Socket positions, frog angle, curve and moving-blade throw must be specified by tested track topology before geometry production.
Must match chosen track socket and vehicle collision/stop envelope. No measured dimensions yet.

assets.label: Original working railway signal
assets.owner: railway infrastructure artist and simulation engineer

dimensions.description: Original simplified signal; visible state must match simulation. Source/reference for mechanical construction and dimensions still needed before modelling.

assets.label: Fictional Alpine station and platform kit

dimensions.description: Do not adopt manufacturer kit dimensions or current reserved rectangle as proof of scale. Ratify platform clearance, doors, roof thickness and footprint against rolling stock.
Two coherent original silhouettes with thickness and foundations; use a shared door-height ruler. Do not copy a commercial kit facade or silently rescale to fit.

assets.label: Miniature terrain, paths and pond banks

dimensions.description: Fits authored 0.8 × 0.5 m model board. Vertical envelope, bank slopes and landscape modules require clearance design; no source terrain copied.
Span, deck elevation and abutments must follow supported track and train clearance, not decorative floating track. Dimensioned construction reference still needed.
Internal swept clearance must cover entire consist on supported curves. Terrain roof must fit the case; dimensioned masonry reference still needed.
Choose height/branch spread against model scale and case closure. Manufacturer's 80–120 mm range is context only; variation must preserve collision footprints.
Fir reference supports craft technique only, not deciduous branching. Species-specific references, canopy dimensions and case clearance needed before production.

assets.label: Original lamps, benches, fences, crates and rocks

dimensions.description: Use common HO figure/door ruler; benchmark material thickness and believable placement. Five categories, not five duplicated copies.

assets.label: Calibrated original paint, metals, wood, stone, cloth and glazing

dimensions.description: Physical grain, fibre and aggregate sizes must be authored at model scale. Neutral swatches, wood/stone macro references and roughness calibration still required.

assets.label: Original coherent day and night display lighting

dimensions.description: Light placement/exposure calibrated to actual model and renderer. Reference photography is not an HDR environment licence or a photometric measurement.

assets.label: Original train, whistle, case and interaction sound set

dimensions.description: Original synthesis or newly licensed recordings only; duration, loudness, loops and native interruption behavior are later measurable requirements, not spatial dimensions.
